description.value: Steffich Fine Art is a curated contemporary gallery founded in 1992 on Salt Spring Island, now one of the Gulf Islands' most recognized cultural landmarks after more than three decades of operation. The gallery represents an eclectic roster including works by Norval Morrisseau, Robert Bateman, and Abraham Anghik Ruben, alongside a unique Rock & Roll Art collection of vintage Fillmore West concert posters and Canada's sole representation of kinetic wind sculptor Lyman Whitaker. Cyclists visiting Salt Spring Island will find this a distinctive stop in a community renowned for its outsized artistic output.
